CONFIRMED (a): L2-granularity indexing is impossible here. 21 index cells per event means 32/item, a 343-item capacity and 34 permille against a 90 permille gate; 900 items would cost 28800 units = 2.6x the whole cap. The remainder leaves 359/300 units of index per item, so the design is a SINGLE-POSTING handle index (1 cell/item): MinHash deleted, the other atoms deleted, discrimination moved to exact containment verification at query time, which costs state nothing.

CONFIRMED (b): per-eviction tombstones are impossible. One cell per eviction gives 12n + (10000-n) <= 11000, so n <= 90 items = 9 permille — a tenfold shortfall on the layer's own coverage gate. Designed an AGGREGATED forgetting record instead: per-t-range (evicted_count, evicted_mass) accumulators, 16 buckets coarsened by width-doubling, stated total cost 3 + 2*buckets <= 35 cells and 23 on the frozen streams — constant in the number of evictions.

CHOSE Letta S4 form B (true eviction now + recorded L4 co-design intent), with form A priced and refuted: 32h + 12c + 23 <= 11000 affords a full-granularity hot tier of at most 8 items at the bare gate and 0 at the occupancy form B actually reaches, because each hot item costs 1.67 cold ones. A two-budget design whose hot tier holds 8 of 10000 items is a decoration with a name. Recorded the intent that S4's demotion-into-consolidated-form is deferred to L4 because a cold tier is only affordable once L4 compression makes an entry cost less than the event it came from.

Composition, tight and asserted: 12n + record <= 11000 -> 914 items, occupancy 10991, unweighted-C 91 permille. Also asserted the cliff: at 13 units/item the capacity is 844 items and 84 permille — a red gate. The whole margin is 14 items.

Importance is structural and exact: grammar_weight x sum over uses of 1/(now+1-u) — ACT-R's optimized frequency-x-recency form, harmonic d=1, exact Fractions, float d=0.5 not reproduced. Only ordering and threshold bind; the eviction hot loop compares (numerator, denominator) pairs by integer cross-multiplication, so no Fraction is built per item and the ordering is identical to the rational one.

uses counts DISTINCT payloads, first occurrence only — and the rule holds at the door as well as afterwards. Fixing that (an arriving repetition inherits its cluster's standing but not its own arrival) was the one engine change the strains forced.

GATE CLEARED on l3streamb per R1: weighted-C 917, unweighted-C 91, F 1000, F_strict 190, B 1000, wrong 0, fabricated 0 — 1 permille off the 918 oracle ceiling, against baselines pinned at 100 and a capped engine at 34. l3stream scored as the ungated diagnostic: 174 against its own 190 ceiling, B 1000.

Strain (a): the attacked set survives WHOLE — 30/30 defended heavy items at flood sizes 50, 200 and 800, with the flood's footprint identical (31 slots) at every size and the cluster holding exactly ONE use however many copies are retained. The naive reference count, computed as a trial fixture and never as engine code, reaches 17x the weakest defended item's activation and would have swept the set.

Strain (b): murk at a 90-item cap (1399 of 1500 forgotten) — twins carry equal importance and are excluded from their cluster's uses (facts, not restatements), a repetition never evicts the fact it repeats (asserted as a forbidden outcome), wrong = 0 under full dirt, and contradiction pairs resolve EXACTLY by the field that differs where L2 could only abstain.

Strain (c): byte-identical snapshots across identical replays; a declared-safe permutation (adjacent, equal weight, distinct handles) leaves the retained payload multiset and the record's count and mass invariant; and moving an item across the stream lawfully changes what survives, asserted so the safe class is not vacuous.

Made the L4 humility seam a WITNESS rather than a promise: two streams differing only in the content of an evicted item produce byte-identical snapshots, so a forgotten payload leaves no trace in state at all and no injective map from the evicted set into 16 pairs of integers exists. Reconstruction from L3 state is impossible in principle, not merely hard — that is what humility/l4/IMPOSSIBILITY.md should be written against.

Stated the residuals rather than hiding them: flood copies still occupy slots while their cluster is recent (31 of 400, bounded and non-scaling) and distinct payloads under one handle do legitimately raise its reference count — both are redundancy reconciliation, which is L4. Two strains in trials/strain/l4/t_demotion_seam.py, both designed from measured field notes in shell/dogfood/FIELD.md rather than from the layer's own prose, plus the engine fix the second one demanded. STRAIN 1 — BLOCKING (Schacter, autopsy/GAPMAP.md §6): the ONE GENUINE GAP the PULSE seven-sin audit named (line 24 — "Layer 4 opened a NEW blocking surface that no trial measures", recommended and not ruled), stated over ASSERTIONS rather than prose episodes on the field note's own redirect (2026-07-26, THE DEMOTION SEAM: asked whether a demoted session summary is still reachable by cue, the honest answer refutes the question — no session summary is EVER demoted, because a prose episode is irreducible to the frozen facet map and pressure FORGETS it instead). Measured on corpora/l4stream at the ratified footprint (43295 of 43300 cells, 250‰): (a) all 18788 demoted events return BYTE-EXACT from read(t) and the two provenance kinds partition every answer — `derive` for an event the schema regenerated, `recall` for one still stored — so the engine is not merely right, it says which channel it was right from; (b) not one of the 18788 cues built from a demoted event's own payload is answered — 18788/18788 ABSTAIN, 0 answered, 0 wrong, the abstention §3.0 pays 100 for against the confident neighbour it pays 0 for; (c) all 498 held episodes are still recalled exactly, so what is asserted is a channel the budget CLOSED and not an index this trial BROKE. The number the prose never carried: the cue channel reaches 498 of the 19286 events read(t) still answers — 26‰. A NON-CAPABILITY BY ARITHMETIC, not by omission, and README-l4 §0.1 is where it comes from (at 250‰ exactly one access path is affordable — an exact t→pair index costs a third cell per assertion, 343‰ — so the associative path is the one the budget does not buy): demoted content is t-ADDRESSABLE, NOT CUE-ADDRESSABLE. The trial pins the behaviour so it cannot change silently in either direction; a dated non-capability note in README-l4 §4 says why it is what it is, with no historical line rewritten. STRAIN 2 — THE FORGETTING RECORD MUST BIND: autopsy/GAPMAP.md §2's engine thesis ("recorded but never binding" — every engine autopsied writes the metadata that would make it correct and then never reads it where it counts) turned on OUR OWN engine at the place a field note found it true (2026-07-26, the atlas-None seam: a payload that reads as an assertion but does NOT invert sets atlas[key]=None, and when the budget then releases its episode the engine books it as a DEMOTION while read(t) abstains on it forever — 8 such writes at a 40-cell cap gave demotions 7, forgetting-record count 0, read(0) None, so the ledger said nothing was lost and the content was gone). RED FIRST, and the recorded failure is the trial's own message: "the engine books 7 demotions but regenerates 0 events". What the trial demands is truthful ACCOUNTING and not a particular policy — a non-invertible fold is either FORGOTTEN (the record gains its count and its mass, read(t) abstains consistently) or REFUSED demotion and held as an episode, or refused outright under §4.1.2 with t unspent and the state unchanged — and it is NEVER booked as demoted while unregenerable; every identity is asserted against the PARTITION read off the ordinary query interface (§7), never against the counters' own arithmetic, which is the difference between a ledger that closes and a ledger that is true. THE ENGINE FIX, one line: THE DEMOTION INVARIANT IS INVERTIBILITY. `atlas_after` is now the ONE reading of the atlas transition, computed once per write and threaded through _accept/_apply_schema, so the entry the atlas ends up carrying and the entry the write path demoted by cannot be two different answers; an assertion whose key does not invert answers Q1/Q2 exactly, is stored where the inherited Layer-3 forgetting law can see it, and if released is released INTO THE RECORD. `_reconcile_lost_key` corrects the bookings made BEFORE a key's inversion dies — held episodes leave the demotable tier, already-released ones become recorded losses and the demotion counter gives them back — atomically on the write that kills the key, so a write that goes on to refuse leaves key and ledger exactly as it found them. `_shed_until` gained the same three-case rule (still held → not a loss and it leaves the demotable tier; already recorded → never recorded twice; otherwise → a loss the demotion counter gives back), which is what makes README-l4 §2.3's closing ledger hold on states with SHED CHAINS, where the frozen strain could state it only at damaged=0. Measured after the fix: the reproduction books 0 demotions, 6 recorded losses with mass, 1 held episode and one deterministic refusal, read(t) abstaining on exactly the 6; the flip fixture's 7 false demotions become 0 against 9 recorded losses and survive a snapshot round trip; the mixed fixture (an invertible attr, a non-invertible attr, an irreducible note and a link) closes at the footprint — 33 held / 192 demoted / 159 lost — and below it — 2 / 154 / 228 with 3 entities damaged by shedding — with occupancy accounted, the budget law held and both replays byte-identical.
